comments.text:
To emphasize why the stance is bad, most of the combos have really poor average damage-multipliers for the amount of time they take, and some of them have a questionable lack of procs. They were likely trying to prevent anything crazy back in the day due to the 100% Follow Through, but it goes too far in the “play it safe” direction.

It’s a giant buzzsaw designed for combat. “Safe” is not this weapon’s middle name.
